metas.name: 2026 · The Final Problem
metas.description: In 1959, 13 people are stranded on an islet near Mallorca during a storm. At their small hotel, English tourist Elisa Mander is found dead. When suicide seems unlikely, retired actor Basil, once Sherlock Holmes on screen, investig...

metas.name: 2026 · The Blame
metas.description: Two detectives fall in love while investigating a murder, until one becomes a suspect.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2026 · Neagley
metas.description: Neagley, drawing from her experience with Jack Reacher and the 110 Special Investigators, embarks on a perilous mission to expose a sinister threat, risking her life to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: 2026 · The Perfect Lie
metas.description: Four couples in a tight-knit group enjoy an extravagant lifestyle. When one of their villas burns down and a member dies, their web of lies begins to unravel.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · Mousetrap
metas.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

metas.name: 2026 · Blood Sacrifice
metas.description: A Stockholm detective must team up with his estranged ex-cop father to catch a serial killer targeting police officers, forcing them to resolve their differences during the investigation.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Lanterns
metas.description: Lanterns follows new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · The Shards
metas.description: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · The Idaho Murders: College Nightmare
metas.description: Chronicles one of the most chilling murder cases in recent memory — honoring the four young lives that were taken while tracing every step from the night of the killings to the eventual arrest of a suspect.

metas.name: 2026 · Furious
metas.description: A determined FBI agent delves into a female killer's history while partnering with a seasoned investigator to track her down.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Lucky
metas.description: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

metas.name: 2026 · The Westies
metas.description: In 1980s Hell's Kitchen, the Westies crime gang eyes profits from the Javitz Center construction. Though vastly outnumbered by Italian mafia, their brutality earns them a share. Generational tensions rise as FBI probes deepen.

metas.name: 2026 · Human Vapor
metas.description: A man gains the ability to transform into a gaseous state uses his powers for bank robberies.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Agent Kim Reactivated
metas.description: Manager Kim was an ordinary head of a household with a daughter and lived as a small citizen. In order to find his daughter, who is his everything, he reveals a secret that should never be revealed to the world.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · I Will Find You
metas.description: A father imprisoned for his son's murder receives evidence suggesting his child may be alive, compelling him to escape and uncover the truth.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2026 · Cape Fear
metas.description: A happily married couple faces a growing threat when a notorious killer from their past, Max Cady, is released from prison and seeks revenge.

metas.name: 2026 · The Witness
metas.description: New resident witnesses a crime in his apartment complex but stays silent when police seek an eyewitness. His choice allows the crime to go unsolved, leading to escalating danger.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Spider-Noir
metas.description: Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down-on-his-luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city's one and only superhero.

metas.name: 2026 · Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
metas.description: Berlin reunites his crew in Seville for an elaborate con targeting a powerful duke and his wife who've made the mistake of trying to blackmail him. Their plan involves faking the theft of a priceless painting as cover.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2026 · Nemesis
metas.description: LA crime drama pits master thief Coltrane Wilder against detective Isaiah Stiles, challenging heist genre norms while examining what drives, sustains and destroys people.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Believe Me
metas.description: It follows the victims of a serial rapist as they fight to get their cases heard after police failures set him free. Eight years after his conviction, they fight again to keep him imprisoned.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Legends
metas.description: Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · M.I.A.
metas.description: Etta Tiger Jonze seeks to avenge her family's murder and become the most powerful crime queenpin in South Florida.

metas.name: 2026 · Man on Fire
metas.description: Follows John Creasy, a wounded former mercenary on a quest to get revenge for the loss of his only companion while defending the daughter of his dead colleague from the forces that tore her family apart.

metas.name: 2026 · Prisoner
metas.description: Follows a young prison officer transporting a high-value prisoner to testify against his crime syndicate, with their relationship evolving throughout the dangerous journey.
